About Us

Crafting Memories Through Culinary Excellence

For nearly three decades, Radha Madhav Caterers has been the trusted name in premium vegetarian catering. We believe that food is not just sustenance—it's an experience, a memory, a celebration of life itself.

Our Story

Founded in 1995, Radha Madhav Caterers began with a simple vision: to serve authentic, wholesome vegetarian cuisine that honors tradition while embracing innovation. What started as a modest catering service has blossomed into one of the region's most celebrated names in event catering.

Every dish we prepare carries the essence of our heritage—recipes passed down through generations, perfected over time, and served with unwavering dedication to quality. Our chefs are artisans, our ingredients are premium, and our commitment to your satisfaction is absolute.
